# Decision record template

Use a new unused Dxxx ID; replace this title and add an exact ID heading. Do not reuse an open-decision ID for the record.

- **Status / date:** Proposed, accepted, or superseded; identify evidence of acceptance.
- **Owner:** Named only if assigned; otherwise unassigned.
- **Question / problem:** Link related Oxx and source evidence.
- **Decision and rationale:** Separate agreed behavior from recommendations; describe alternatives/tradeoffs when meaningful.
- **Affected components/contracts/requirements:** Links to canonical IDs; compatibility and behavioral effects.
- **Implementation status / validation:** Inspected state and actual evidence, or planned checks.
- **Unresolved consequences / supersedes:** Preserve earlier rationale and link replacements.

Retain the original Oxx section and link its resolution here; add the record to the [index](../README.md). Follow [maintenance](../maintenance.md).
